name: Jägerstüberl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Hunters' Hut in Grainau** --- **

Tradition & Alpine Charm in the Heart of the Alps

** Welcome to the **Jägerstüberl** in **Grainau**, a cozy mountain inn nestled in the breathtaking **Tirol** landscape. Just a short walk from the **Partnach Gorge** and the **Zugspitze**, this rustic retreat invites you to savor authentic Bavarian hospitality with a touch of Alpine flair. --- **

Our Menu – A Feast for the Senses

** Indulge in hearty dishes crafted from the finest local ingredients. Try our signature **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized, and dusted with powdered sugar—served with fresh berries or a dollop of **Apfelmus**. For meat lovers, our **Tiroler Gröstl** (a hearty potato and meat hash) or a juicy **Schweinsbraten** (roast pork) with **Knödel** (dumplings) and **Sauerkraut** will leave you satisfied. Pair your meal with a cold **Tiroler Bier** from the region’s finest breweries or a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** from Austria’s vineyards. And don’t forget to warm up with a steaming cup of **Glühwein** (mulled wine) or a creamy **Kaffee mit Schlagobers** (coffee with whipped cream). --- **

Relax & Unwind

** After your meal, unwind in our cozy **Stüberl** (tavern) with a game of **Skatt** (a traditional Bavarian card game) or simply enjoy the crackling fireplace. The **Jägerstüberl** is the perfect spot to connect with fellow travelers, swap stories, and soak in the warmth of Alpine tradition. --- **
